reason: A local observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness that records agent turns, model steps, tool calls, errors, and related telemetry in an embedded yiTrace database for debugging and historical querying.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体会话、模型步骤、工具调用和错误遥测记录到本地嵌入式 yiTrace 数据库中，便于调试与查询。
summaries.en: Records DeepSeek Harness agent turns, model steps, tool calls, errors, and related telemetry in a local embedded yiTrace database for debugging and querying.

capabilities: Observes post-telemetry DeepSeek Harness session records
Stores model, message, reasoning, tool-call, error, and session data in a local embedded yiTrace database
Creates and queries local traces, spans, logs, and full-text search indexes
Persists data to a configured local directory without opening a network connection
